title: Figure 22. Deoxyribozyme E6 basic gate structures for tic-tac-toe automaton
description: Five-panel figure (a–e) of DNA secondary structures derived from deoxyribozyme E6, labeled "YESi1," "NOTi6," "i1ANDi6," and "i1ANDi3ANDNOTi6," each with input strands, a truth table, and a small logic-gate symbol diagram. Captioned "Figure 22. Basic gate structures, derived from allosterically regulated deoxyribozyme E6, for playing tic-tac-toe against a human opponent." Appears under "Deoxyribozyme-based Boolean Automata."
